Printed edition: J.G. Seume's sämmtliche Werke, 1837, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/11723924bsb. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 38%, 74%, 53% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Christian August Heinrich Clodius, Johann Veit Friedrich Schnorr von Carolsfeld, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
